parsed.summary: The PR simplifies the code by using subprocess.run and PGPASSWORD, but it removes the handling of UnicodeEncodeError, which could lead to a functional issue.

issues.description: The PR removes the handling of UnicodeEncodeError, which could cause the password input to fail if the current locale can't encode the data.
